name: Hippo Holdings Inc.
summary: Hippo Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides property and casualty insurance products to individuals and business customers primarily in the United States. The company provides a multi-carrier platform through owned and partner managing general agents (MGAs), serving as a licensed insurance carrier for MGAs and providing admitted and non-admitted (excess and surplus) paper, regulatory licenses, and reinsurance across multiple lines of business. The company also offers insurance products, including homeowners, renters, commercial multi-peril, casualty, and other specialty insurance programs.
